name: habari-mcp
description: MCP server for Kenya civic information — Kenya Gazette, government tenders, open data, parliament tracker, citizen feedback channels

tools.name: gazette_search
tools.description: Explain the types of notice in the Kenya Gazette (legal notices, appointments, company notices and others) and where to read the Gazette. Use when someone asks what a Gazette notice type is or how to find one. search_type matches a type by name; an unrecognised type returns an error listing the valid ones. date_range is only echoed back. This tool does NOT search the Gazette. Returns the type description and the access points (kenyalaw.org). Labelled DEMO. Read-only; no side effects.

tools.name: tender_search_guide
tools.description: Where to find Kenyan public tenders and what bidders need: the IFMIS eTender portal, county eProcurement, the Gazette, eligibility documents and tender value thresholds. Use when someone asks how to find or qualify for a tender. sector and county are only echoed back; this tool does NOT list live tenders. Returns the portals, eligibility requirements and thresholds. Labelled DEMO: confirm at tenders.go.ke. Read-only; no side effects.

tools.name: open_data_guide
tools.description: Where to find Kenyan open data by topic (population, health, budget and others) with the publisher, URL and format. Use when someone asks where to get official data. data_type matches a category by name; if none match, the general Kenya Open Data portal is returned. Returns the matching sources and all_categories. Portal addresses labelled DEMO and subject to change. Read-only; no side effects.

tools.name: parliament_tracker
tools.description: How to follow the Parliament of Kenya: the bills tracker, Hansard, committees and related. Use when someone asks how to track a bill or find a debate. Keywords in query_type select entries; if none match, ALL guidance is returned. This tool does NOT fetch live bill status. Returns the information and the parliament.go.ke portal. Labelled DEMO. Read-only; no side effects.

tools.name: citizen_feedback_channels
tools.description: Where to report a problem to Kenyan authorities by issue type, such as corruption (EACC) or service delivery, with contact details. Use when someone asks where to complain. Keywords in issue_type select channels; if none match, the eCitizen portal is returned. Returns the channels and all_categories. Contact numbers are labelled DEMO and unverified: confirm before relying. Read-only; no side effects.
